proof.criterion: The boundary rig models a pod-owned disk rather than one that outlives the pod, and the plant vectors prove fresh-disk isolation rather than inheritance.
proof.surface: The package's own init rig, which runs the real init containers against real git and jj over host directories.
proof.command: cd packages/daemon && CGO_ENABLED=0 go test ./internal/runtime/sandbox -run TestWhatAnIssuePlants -v
proof.observed: All nine vectors PASS. A generic ephemeral volume now maps to the pod's own directory; a Sandbox-owned claim still maps to the shared one. Each vector plants on pod 1, restarts pod 1 so the plant meets the disk it was left on, runs its live control there, then starts pod 2 of the same issue, which finds an empty disk, adds no sink line and reaches no named host.
proof.negativeControl: Run by me, not taken from the worker: restoring `dir = rig.tree` for the ephemeral case with no production change fails **9 of 9** vectors. So the rig can tell the two worlds apart, which is what the aliasing had cost it.

proof.criterion: Each sentence rewritten in the last two rounds says what its path does.
proof.surface: The daemon's own source, read before each sentence was written — the citations above are the lines read.
proof.observed: `issueClose`'s comment no longer claims the release deletes an issue Sandbox; it says the release ends this role's process and forgets the claim, that only the controller's Sandbox goes that way, and that an issue's pod goes with the separately fenced `IssueSuspend` or the tree cleanup — which is why a merged close leaves the implementer's pod standing. The architect skill no longer says the Sandbox goes `only when a look reports pending`: it goes whenever the check pauses between looks or closes, and only a `pending` whose next wake is already queued starts another look on the same pod. `podsafety.go` no longer says no disk a pod mounts outlives it; the controller's does, by design.
proof.negativeControl: The citations are the control: a reviewer reads them and finds the sentence either supported or not. The three sentences replaced this round were each wrong in a way their vaguer predecessors never risked, which is why the discipline is the citation rather than more care.

discoveredComplexity: Each replacement states the mechanism more precisely than its author had read it. 'Only when a look reports pending' is a sharper claim than the vague sentence it replaced and wrong for a reason the vague one never risked; the remedy is not more care in the same direction but reading the path the sentence describes, and citing the lines read where a reviewer can check them.

A fixture that aliases two worlds cannot tell them apart, and the cost is invisible while the tests pass: this rig passed nine vectors against a model in which a pod's own disk outlives the pod, and failed all nine the moment the aliasing was restored against the corrected test.
